essence: The figure is to be depicted with matted hair spread and standing on both sides.
The left hand should be arranged to hold a skull and show the boon-giving gesture.
The right hand should be made to hold a peacock feather.
Alternatively, the right hand should be arranged joined with a corner.
The distance from the navel to the wrist is declared to be sixteen aṅgulas.
